subject: Confirmation of 05/09 checkout degradation window, credit eligibility, and RCAs
messages:
From: Emma Rivera <emma@shopvocal.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@skyline-payments.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Checkout errors and elevated 503s during peak — need window confirmation

Jordan —

We saw a sustained spike of 503s on our checkout route between 02:14:30 UTC and 02:27:45 UTC on 2029-05-09 which led to roughly 7% failed payments during a 12-minute window. Our payments team flagged the impact immediately; this caused a measurable revenue loss during our morning flash-sale.

Can you confirm Redwood's observed window and let us know whether this meets SLA criteria for a credit? Please also include the timeframe for a formal postmortem and what evidence you need from our side.

I've attached a short CSV with our retry counts and a couple of request-ids (snippet) to help correlate traces.

Thanks —
Emma Rivera
Sr. Reliability Engineer, ShopVocal
emma@shopvocal.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: shopvocal-0509-snippet.csv (text/csv)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Rivera <emma@shopvocal.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout errors and elevated 503s during peak — need window confirmation

Emma — thanks for the heads-up and the request-ids. We're pulling traces now. Initial ask: can you confirm whether ShopVocal saw any client-side retry suppression during that interval (some customers have aggressive backoffs that reduce apparent impact)? Also, can you share the HubSpot ticket id for the sales incident so I can link our remediation work?

Our plan: 1) correlate your request-ids with Redwood ingress logs, 2) produce an availability delta calculation per the SLA, 3) confirm whether the event meets the threshold for a credit and propose a remedy (credit amount or pro-rata). We aim to share the verified window and a preliminary eligibility determination within 24 hours.

I'll loop in David for the raw log extraction and Laura for customer comms.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Enterprise 
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout errors and elevated 503s during peak — need window confirmation

Jordan/Laura —

I pulled the edge and serving logs for the timeframe Emma noted. Short summary from the infra side: between 02:14:22 and 02:28:00 UTC we observed elevated 503 responses on the checkout shard serving ShopVocal traffic. Root cause appears to be a transient autoscaler allocation delay after a multi-region failover; a subset of pods didn't reattach KV cache fast enough which amplified cold-path latency and produced 503s when request queues filled.

I've produced an initial availability delta: ShopVocal saw a 7.2% increase in failed tokenized responses versus baseline for that 12-minute slice (raw calc attached). Per the SLA (section 3.1), this is above the 5% threshold for proportional remedy consideration for that minute-range.

Action items I'm proposing:
- Confirm minute-aligned window with ShopVocal; we should use 02:14:22–02:28:00 UTC.
- Offer prorated credit for impacted minutes (our finance template attached to draft the figure).
- Run a focused postmortem that covers autoscaler behavior, KV warmup, and failover routing; target PM to complete within 7 business days.

I'm attaching: svc-logs-0509-utc.zip (logs), raw-availability-calc.csv, and a postmortem skeleton.

-David
David Kim
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.ai

Attachments: svc-logs-0509-utc.zip (application/zip), raw-availability-calc.csv (text/csv)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Rivera <emma@shopvocal.com>, Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@skyline-payments.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 May 2029 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout errors and elevated 503s during peak — need window confirmation

Emma/Carlos — quick update. Internal SRE has validated the interval as 02:14:22–02:28:00 UTC on 2029-05-09. The initial availability delta calculation indicates this meets the SLA proportional-remedy criteria.

What we need from you to finalize the credit:
- Confirmation that the listed window aligns with your client-side telemetry (you already provided request-ids which helped).
- Signed credit request form (we attach a PDF for completion).

Next steps: once we receive the signed form I'll route to Finance for a credit calculation and to Legal for any required contract exception sign-off. We'll also schedule the postmortem; David and Soojin will circulate the draft to you for review. Expect a credit estimate and postmortem invite by end of Monday (2029-05-13).

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: signed-credit-request.pdf (placeholder to be returned by customer)
From: Emma Rivera <emma@shopvocal.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@skyline-payments.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 May 2029 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Checkout errors and elevated 503s during peak — need window confirmation

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the logs. Confirming ShopVocal's client-side telemetry aligns to the 02:14:22–02:28:00 UTC window. I've completed and attached the signed-credit-request.pdf and included a brief revenue-impact note for Finance. Please proceed with the credit calculation and postmortem. We appreciate the interim analysis and look forward to the RCA meeting.

Best,
Emma Rivera
Sr. Reliability Engineer, ShopVocal

Attachments: signed-credit-request.pdf (application/pdf), shopvocal-revenue-impact-brief.pdf (application/pdf)
